meta.task: Design a battery for grid energy storage: energy density >= 327.18 Wh/kg; 4C fast charge without lithium plating; anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 cycles of 1C cycling; discharge capacity retention >= 90% at -20 degC; SEI <= 550 nm after 500 cycles.

ablation.ceiling_escalation: ON (default, not mentioned in task text)
ablation.funnel_voting: ON (default, not mentioned in task text)

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (widest; task text silent) - baseline Chen2020 per anchor-table default rule (no electrode system named)
freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: adjustable (widest; task text silent) - sigma/t+/D transport parameter overrides allowed
freedoms.electrode_modification: adjustable (widest; task text silent) - coating/dopant candidates allowed (SEI suppression via parameter bridge)
freedoms.cell_architecture: adjustable (widest; task text silent) - thickness/porosity/N-P/separator/current collector/particle size all levers
freedoms.thermal_management: adjustable (widest; task text silent) - cooling h lever available

meta.base_reason: task text names no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite teaching parameterization; aging-capable with SEI kinetics; cell-level thermal/geometry defaults injected by run-pyamm with trace)

derived_metrics.sei_thickness_nm_500cyc: mechanical copy of aging_1C_100cyc --cycles 500 output key sei_thickness_nm_end, renamed with cycle-count suffix so the 500-cycle contract (max 550 nm) and 100-cycle contract (max 500 nm) are judged under distinct criteria keys (run-pyamm emits the same key name for both aging files)
derived_metrics.lowT_retention_pct: 100 x capacity_ah(lowT_discharge at 253.15 K) / capacity_ah(1C_discharge at 298.15 K), same parameter set and same params overrides; mechanically computed from the two run-pyamm outputs

meta.notes: headless zero-interaction run: no clarification questions; thresholds parsed verbatim from task text; unspecified parameters take protocol defaults (real_compute=false; start_stage=3 since task names no new materials; freedoms widest per t1_r1 lesson)
